comment: TLS-Anvil skip list for tls. Patterns are matched against the test display name, stable test id, and DISABLED reason using case-sensitive shell-style globbing (Python fnmatch). Each skip must cite a GitHub issue or an explicit out-of-scope/tool-state decision.

skip.pattern: *Target does not send a Hello Retry Request*
skip.reason: TLS-Anvil disables cases when its configured peer path does not trigger HRR; tls HRR has separate local and external coverage
TLS-Anvil runner does not provision caller-owned PSK/ticket state; resumption has separate local and OpenSSL coverage

skip.pattern: *Server does not issue Session Tickets and might ignore the extension*
skip.reason: tls accepts externally managed PSKs but does not issue server tickets through this TLS-Anvil runner
TLS-Anvil runner does not provision the PSK/ticket state required for 0-RTT; core coverage is separate
record_size_limit is intentionally outside the supported surface (#34)
TLS-Anvil @Disabled because this runner does not issue the session tickets needed for server-side EarlyData tests
max_fragment_length is intentionally outside the supported surface (#34)

skip.pattern: *Client does not support maximum fragment length*
skip.reason: max_fragment_length is intentionally outside the supported surface (#34)
DTLS is out of scope
TLS 1.2 is out of scope
TLS 1.2 is out of scope

skip.pattern: *TLS 1.2 is not supported by the server.*
skip.reason: TLS 1.2 is out of scope
TLS 1.0/1.1/1.2 compatibility behavior is out of scope
FFDHE named groups are outside the supported TLS 1.3 surface

skip.pattern: *Sender restrictions are not expected to be enforced*
skip.reason: TLS-Anvil disabled sender-restriction test; no execution evidence
TLS-Anvil client runner cannot derive this record-fragmentation case; no execution evidence
TLS compression is outside the TLS 1.3-only runner scope (#9)
tls accepts externally managed PSKs but this server runner does not issue NewSessionTicket messages
TLS-Anvil disables this client-side PSK test; pre_shared_key ordering has separate local coverage
TLS-Anvil runner does not provision caller-owned PSK/ticket state; PSK mode coverage is separate

skip.pattern: *The DisablePsk config option is not tested.*
skip.reason: TLS-Anvil configuration-option self-test is not tls conformance evidence

skip.pattern: *ProtocolVersion of the test is not supported by the target*
skip.reason: TLS 1.2/DTLS/legacy-version tests are out of scope for the TLS 1.3-only runner (#9)

skip.pattern: *Client does not support legacy rsa signature and hash algorithms*
skip.reason: TLS-Anvil cannot derive this legacy-signature negative case for the TLS 1.3-only client runner (#9)

skip.pattern: *Specific features required for the test have not been met by the SUT for derivation parameter CIPHER_SUITE*
skip.reason: ServerKeyExchange is not a TLS 1.3 message; out of scope for the TLS 1.3-only runner (#9)

skip.pattern: *Target does not provide Ciphersuites that are supported by the test.*
skip.reason: legacy compression/cipher-suite compatibility behavior is out of scope for the TLS 1.3-only runner (#9)
